title: Duckling in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='28' ry='22' fill='#FFD93B'/>
  <!-- body shading -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='24' ry='15' fill='#FFC107'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='20' fill='#FFE44D'/>
  <!-- head highlight -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='36' r='10' fill='#FFF176' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- left wing -->
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='66' rx='10' ry='14' fill='#FFC107' transform='rotate(-15 26 66)'/>
  <!-- right wing -->
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='66' rx='10' ry='14' fill='#FFC107' transform='rotate(15 74 66)'/>
  <!-- scarf -->
  <path d='M32 55 Q50 64 68 55 L68 61 Q50 70 32 61 Z' fill='#E8453C'/>
  <!-- scarf tail -->
  <path d='M64 59 L70 78 L62 80 L58 62 Z' fill='#F25C54'/>
  <!-- scarf stripes -->
  <rect x='33' y='56' width='6' height='6' fill='#FFD93B' transform='rotate(8 33 56)'/>
  <rect x='45' y='59' width='6' height='6' fill='#FFD93B' transform='rotate(3 45 59)'/>
  <rect x='57' y='56' width='6' height='6' fill='#FFD93B' transform='rotate(-5 57 56)'/>
  <!-- scarf tail stripe -->
  <rect x='61' y='68' width='5' height='5' fill='#FFD93B' transform='rotate(15 61 68)'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='40' r='4' fill='#2D2D2D'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='40' r='4' fill='#2D2D2D'/>
  <!-- eye shine -->
  <circle cx='44.5' cy='38.5' r='1.6' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='58.5' cy='38.5' r='1.6' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <path d='M43 48 Q50 56 57 48 Q50 50 43 48 Z' fill='#FF8C00'/>
  <!-- beak line -->
  <path d='M44 49.5 Q50 52 56 49.5' stroke='#E07B00' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='37' cy='46' r='3.5' fill='#FFAB91' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='46' r='3.5' fill='#FFAB91' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <path d='M38 88 L30 94 L36 94 L40 91 L42 94 L48 94 L42 88 Z' fill='#FF8C00'/>
  <path d='M58 88 L52 88 L58 94 L64 94 L62 91 L66 94 L72 94 L64 88 Z' fill='#FF8C00'/>
  <!-- duckling tuft on head -->
  <path d='M48 22 Q50 16 54 20 Q52 17 56 18 Q54 14 51 16 Q49 13 47 17 Q46 14 44 18 Q46 17 45 21 Z' fill='#FFE44D'/>
</svg>
